prayerExcerpt.en-US: The constant thought of purgatory will help us not only to escape its dreadful pains, but also to avoid the least imperfection which hinders our approach to God.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: O constante pensamento no purgatório nos ajudará não somente a escapar de suas terríveis penas, mas também a evitar a menor imperfeição que estorve a nossa aproximação de Deus.

meta.face: A Genoese noblewoman of about fifty-five with a pale ivory complexion and a DIAMOND-SHAPED face — a NARROW, high forehead under the wimple, the face WIDEST at HIGH, PROMINENT cheekbones with soft hollows beneath, then narrowing along a lean jaw to a NARROW, firm, pointed chin; a LONG, THIN, HIGH-BRIDGED aquiline nose whose tip turns slightly down, LARGE, deep-set grey-green eyes with faint violet shadows beneath, THIN, sharply ARCHED dark brows, a narrow, thin-lipped mouth; hair hidden; the gaze lifted a little, burning and inward. Not the young, oval catherine_siena, the small, short-nosed colette, the moon-faced catherine_ricci, or the broad, square jane_frances_chantal.
meta.basis: Her iconography is the noble widow in a veil, serving the sick of the Pammatone hospital (Wikipedia; the book's engraving shows her carrying a bowl to a bedside). The Ratti painting on Italian Wikipedia gives a long face with a long nose under a veil; the bone structure is ours.
